# Nodes Table actions Mask

**Module: d2/widgets/nodestable**

Toolbar items mask allows to show or hide actions in toolbar forcefully.
For some toolbars context few actions may not be applicable. 
The toolbar masks allow to suppress the  OOTB D2 actions.

Masking configuration need to be done in "Require JS" configuration file. Ideally the "Require JS" configuration is handled in init javascript file in project(<Project Namespace>-init.js). For Sample refer "d2-init.js".

Masking of actions can be done in two aspects,
* blacklist 
  * Set rule for hiding the passed actions.
* whitelist
  * Set rule for showing only passed actions.

List of command signatures need to passed in blacklist or whitelist. Command signature can be found in command class which extends CommandModel(csui/models/command).

#### Example

```
// Sample for whitelisting and blacklisting in nodestable actions
'd2/widgets/nodestable/toolbaritems.masks': {
    masks: {
        inlineActionbar: {
            blacklist: ['D2-Cut', 'Copy']
        },
        addToolbar: {
            whitelist: ['D2-ImportFile']
        }
    }
}
```

---
### Masks for different menu context
Toolbar masks can be granular level for different menu context. Following are the available menu context in Nodes table.
* Inline action bar(Toolbar Mask key: inlineActionbar) - Row level toolbar shown on hovering over the row.
  ![Table  Toolbar](data:image/png;base64,)
* Table header toolbar(Toolbar Mask key: tableHeaderToolbar) - Table level toolbar shown for one or more selected items in table.
  ![Table Header Toolbar](data:image/png;base64,)
* Left toolbar(Toolbar Mask key: leftToolbar) - Table level toolbar shown in left side header of a table.
  ![Table Left Toolbar](data:image/png;base64,)
* Right toolbar(Toolbar Mask key: rightToolbar) - Table level toolbar shown in right side header of a table.
  ![Right Left Toolbar](data:image/png;base64,)
* Add item toolbar(Toolbar Mask key: addToolbar) - Table level toolbar for a container(Folder/Cabinet) shown on interacting with Add new(+) in table.
  ![Right Left Toolbar](data:image/png;base64,)
---
### Other masks for Container action in NodesTable header and Object actions for Metadata Properties header.
* Masking for Container action in NodesTable header is controlled by 'headermenuitems.mask'(csui/widgets/nodestable/headermenuitems.mask)
  ![Table Container Menu](data:image/png;base64,)
  #### Example
  ```
  // Sample masking for Container action in NodesTable header 
  'csui/widgets/nodestable/headermenuitems.mask': {
      dropdownMenuList: {
          blacklist: ['D2-Cut','Copy']
      }
  }
  ```
* Masking for Object action in Metadata Properties header is controlled by 'header.dropdown.menu.items.mask'(csui/widgets/metadata/header.dropdown.menu.items.mask)
  ![Metadata Object Menu](data:image/png;base64,)
  #### Example
  ```
  // Sample masking for Object action in Metadata Properties header 
  'csui/widgets/metadata/header.dropdown.menu.items.mask': {
      dropdownMenuList: {
          blacklist: ['D2-Cut','Copy']
      }
  }
  ```
